ns2:course.label: Creative Thesis Project
ns2:course.description: The design, implementation, and completion of a culminating creative project in choreography and/or performance. May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: 28 hours of graduate work in dance, including 4 hours in choreography.
